Full moon on 16 September 2027

The full moon falls on Thursday, 16 September 2027, at 02:03 Sofia time (23:03 UTC). At that moment the Moon is exactly opposite the Sun and almost 100% lit. It is 399,300 km from Earth.

When and where to watch

The full moon rises around sunset: this evening at 19:29 over the eastern horizon, while the Sun sets at 19:35. The Moon looks best low over the horizon, so watch from an open place with a clear view east. It sets the next morning at 08:34. Times are for Sofia; other cities differ by a few minutes.
